title: Didn’t Stick
text: Didn’t Stick. Tried to stick on clean smooth tile and clean smooth glass. They wouldn’t stick to anything! Amazon refunded my purchase.

product_metadata.title: LUXEAR Shower Suction Cup Hooks, 4 Pack Razor Holder for Inside Shower Removable Reusable Wall Hangers for Bathroom Waterproof Powerful Vacuum Suction Cup Hooks for Loofah Towel Robe Bathrobe Kitchen
features: Heavy Duty & Powerful Suctions - LUXEAR suction cup hooks are using high-strength PVC material and updated vacuum technology, it can MAX load up to 11lbs. The shower razor holders are made of waterproof TPE suction cups which can firmly stick to the tile even in a damp environment and will not turn yellow or reduce adhesion over time.

Multi-Purpose Using - LUXEAR razor holder hooks are suitable for multi-purposes. You can hang razor, towel, loofah, sponge, coat, key, earphones, wreath, hangers, spoons, beater, spatula, scissors, clothes, cables; Also for more places: bathroom, kitchen, window, wall, door, counters.

Easy Installation - Clean the surface and keep the surface dry before use. (Please be sure the surface is a smooth surface) Peel off the cover. (NOTE: Do not touch the adhesive surface by hand); Press the basic of the hook and touch steady from middle to edge; Pull down the hooks to lock; Make sure the basic of the hook contact with the wall totally; Squeeze the air out totally. Make sure to vacuum.

Removable & Reusable & Adjustable - Our shower hooks are removable, and they won’t leave any marks on the wall after being removed. They are reusable; rinse them in the water and dry them later, then they are available again! If you are renting, you might want to leave your apartment in good condition before moving out, or you want to save the trouble of asking for permission before drilling holes; these loofah hooks would be perfectly suitable.

Ideal for Use On Multi-Surfaces - LUXEAR wall hook is suitable for use on SMOOTH, clean, dry, flat, and NON-POROUS surfaces, such as glass, mirror, smooth tile, smooth polished metal, stainless steel, and acrylic. Please note that these vacuum suction hooks CAN NOT be used on oiled surfaces, unfinished marble, rough surface, over grout line lime wall, emulsion varnish, wallpaper, non-painted wood, mosaic, etc.
